Taylor (AE): FYI Neptune Labs submitted a full CAIQ + a short PCI appendix (two BYOK/HSM questions). POC demo Tue 10am PST, they want answers before the demo. Who can triage?
Amanda R: I can take the first pass today. I'll map to our canonical CAIQ responses and flag gaps. tagging @Raj P for security review.
Raj P: Please paste the doc link here so I can see exact wording.
Taylor (AE): Link: https://neptune.example.com/forms/caix-2026 (password in LastPass). It's full CAIQ + PCI appendix lines 3/4 about HSM certs and BYOK lifecycle.
Amanda R: Plan: 1) reuse existing CAIQ answers where we can, 2) mark bespoke PCI bits with owners and rationale, 3) estimate ETA and blockers. I'll upload a diff doc.
Security Bot: Intake created: SEC-4392.
Raj P: For HSM/BYOK we'll need engineering confirmation on Dedicated vs Private vs Hosted. @Linh T can you confirm constraints?
Linh T: Short note: Private supports customer-managed KMS; Dedicated can support BYOK but requires a provisioning ticket and may need provider HSM certs; Hosted (multi-tenant) cannot support BYOK. I'll paste a short BYOK flow into the doc.
Amanda R: ETA initial triage by EOD today. I'll add a red/amber/green status per question and tag items "security-required".
Taylor (AE): Can we commit to 48-72h after triage for full answers? Customer is pushing timeline.
Raj P: 48-72h is doable if no vendor HSM cert procurement is required. If we need partner certs or SOC docs, add extra time.
Amanda R: Uploaded mapping: https://drive.redwood/incoming/neptune-caix-diff.md — top has a short table and inline comments. Owners set in doc: Security=@Raj P, Platform=@Linh T, AE=@Taylor (AE).
Linh T: Adding KMS sample IAM snippet and a brief BYOK checklist: ```1) customer provides KMS ARNs 2) validate IAM permissions 3) configure access controls 4) key rotation per contract```
Raj P: I'll draft suggested security addendum language for BYOK/HSM if we decide to accept.
Security Bot: No active incidents. Linking infra-team for dependency check.
Taylor (AE): Thanks team. I'll tell the customer: triage today, answers in ~48-72h pending any HSM vendor docs.
Amanda R: I'll ping at 5pm with final triage status. :thumbsup:
